about.title: About Me
about.intro: My specialty: translating technical complexity into measurable business value.
description: As a Tech Lead & Business Analyst, I build strategic bridges between executive vision and technical execution. My journey evolved from software engineering to business analysis, where I now optimize the intersection of technology and corporate objectives.
My purpose is to ensure every technology investment delivers clear returns and every business requirement has viable, scalable technical implementation.

business.title: Strategy & Business
business.description: I transform OKRs into actionable roadmaps, optimize processes with data, and ensure stakeholder alignment through effective executive communication.

technical.title: Technology & Delivery
technical.description: I evaluate architectures, optimize performance, and lead agile teams. My technical foundation enables informed strategic decisions and effective communication with engineering teams.

about.current: Today, I apply this hybrid vision in leading digital products, where every technical decision is validated by business metrics and every business initiative is enabled by robust technical solutions.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description: I own the data solutions behind the institute's scholarship selection and mentoring programs.
highlights: Built a People Analytics platform (Python, Streamlit) centralizing 10,000+ scholarship applications from 5 years, with automated cleaning, consolidation and aggregation pipelines.

Delivered interactive dashboards with automated KPIs and executive reports, replacing a process that had no centralized analysis tool and letting leadership track trends and potential bias across selection cycles.
Designed and modeled data warehouse tables, integrating Google Sheets and AWS RDS/MySQL.
Built an AI-powered HR pipeline that extracts and categorizes candidate data from CVs into structured datasets, saving ~$1,000/year in recruitment platform costs.
Automated data workflows with n8n, Zapier, Typeform, GetResponse and Salesforce NPSP.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Led the development of the institute's mentoring platform, from requirements to production.
highlights: Designed and built an internal mentorship and feedback platform serving 3,000+ users, including a migration from an existing MySQL database on AWS RDS with zero data loss.
Designed the data model and backend services behind the platform's workflows and reporting.
Led requirements analysis for the 2025 MVP, delivering 100% of the essential scope aligned with the organization's OKRs.
Set up a CI/CD testing pipeline reaching 90% unit test coverage (target: 80%).

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Worked on the services that process GPS tracker data for a vehicle telematics platform.
highlights: Built and maintained Go microservices that parse and encode GPS tracker data in a distributed processing workflow.
Used RabbitMQ for asynchronous messaging between services, and MongoDB and Redis for storage, querying and caching.
Delivered features and production fixes in a NestJS monolith using DDD, Clean Architecture and TDD.
Fixed 70+ bugs and wrote 120+ automated tests, improving system reliability.

positions.title: Software Developer (Internship)
positions.description: Joined the MVP team of an AI-powered telematics platform (fleet tracking, fuel management and vehicle diagnostics).
highlights: Documented 3 Go microservices with Swagger/OpenAPI, standardizing the specs of internal tracking-data services.
Wrote unit tests and shipped bug fixes across the API and frontend.

positions.title: Data Analyst (Internship)
positions.description: Built the clinic's first centralized KPI dashboards for management.
highlights: Replaced a spreadsheet that took ~20 minutes to load with a Looker Studio dashboard used by 20+ administrative staff.
Collected, cleaned and consolidated data from multiple Google Sheets sources to calculate operational KPIs such as NPS and response time.
Automated data preparation and recurring reports with Google Apps Script.

items.title: People Analytics System for Selection Process
items.subtitle: Automated Analysis and Diversity Indicators
items.description: Development of a data analysis platform for Instituto Semear's youth Selection Process, turning candidate data into an interactive People Analytics dashboard. Automates statistical analysis, diversity indicators, geographic coverage, and insight generation for the selection team's strategic decisions.
items.problem: High volume of historical data without a centralized exploration tool, difficulty understanding the evolution of candidate profiles, and difficulty quickly and reliably identifying biases and trends in the selection process.
approach: Automated pipeline for data cleaning, consolidation, and aggregation
Interactive Streamlit dashboard with dynamic filters
Automatic generation of indicators, charts, and executive reports
Integration with YData Profiling for exploratory data analysis
items.impact: Centralized and more transparent historical analysis of the selection process

items.text: Exceptional technical leader and mentor. Her ability to guide talent development is remarkable. Under her leadership, I evolved significantly: my communication skills became more effective, I gained proficiency in Node.js and many other skills!
items.author: Kessen Lara Gonçalves de Souza
items.role: Full Stack Dev at Instituto Semear

items.text: I met Maria in college, we participated together in Reuni and later had the opportunity to work as interns at the same company. She is super dedicated, learns fast and is always willing to collaborate and teach when someone needs help. She's someone who was very easy to work with and always added value to our daily exchanges. I have great respect for the committed and generous way she gets involved in projects.
items.author: Bárbara Luersen
items.role: Systems Analyst | Business Analyst | Product Owner

items.text: I had the great pleasure of participating with Maria in Reuni Challenge 2023, being a fundamental person for the team with her opinions and skills. Her exceptional combination of technical and interpersonal skills was crucial for the victories achieved during the competition. Her knowledge in various areas, determination, punctuality and drive to make things happen add tremendous value to any team. Meeting and being around people like her is a pleasure.
items.author: Victor Luiz
